svg.title: M05: reconcile observed records against independently expected work
svg.desc: Two source inputs feed preservation: observed gateway, telemetry and ServiceNow records, and an independent expected-work inventory. After recoverable preservation the collector can advance its checkpoint. Parsing and reconciliation produce facts, source status and gaps in M06, which the control modules assess.
svg.text: M05 · What arrived is only half of the evidence.
Proposed acquisition flow · synthetic example · source scope and completion guarantees require verification
M05 WORKER — OUTSIDE THE INFERENCE PATH

g.title: Read authorized records with source scope, filters, versions and pagination status
g.text: Stable IDs, versions and source scope

g.title: The expected-work authority must expose a whole missing telemetry action
g.text: Declared event slots and window members

g.title: Preserve recoverable raw records before durable acknowledgment or checkpoint advancement
g.text: Replay after a crash must be safe

g.title: Deterministic parsers keep unknown or malformed inputs visible
g.text: M03 identities, units and source time

g.title: Read the records permitted for this scope
Preserve expected-work records as source evidence too
Match actual observations against independently required work, without double counting or hiding gaps
g.text: One execution, several observations → one authoritative charge
Four expected executions, three usage records → one unresolved usage gap
Retain conflicts, late corrections, missing sources and known coverage limits

g.title: Normalized observed and expected records enter the same scoped reconciliation

svg.text: M06 RETAINS FACTS AND GAPS — CONTROL MODULES CALCULATE VERDICTS

g.title: The shared workspace retains raw references, reconciled facts, accepted revisions and source status
g.text: M06: facts + source status + explicit gaps
C7 / C9 / C16 assess required inputs against pinned M04 rules
M13 freezes the source versions used by a judge's case

g.title: Persist outputs and status without claiming control satisfaction
Known usage subtotal is not a complete whole-run total

svg.text: All pages fetched ≠ every required event captured. Freshness ≠ completeness. A downloaded malformed record still needs resolution.
Deterministic parsers handle structured fields. M11 Nemotron later proposes cited interpretations of unstructured notes.
